title: Policy Search in Code Space for Multi-Agent Pathfinding
abstract: arXiv:2610.25946v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Developing coordination policies for complex multi-agent systems relies on either labor-intensive algorithm design or opaque task-specific reinforcement learning. With recent advances in autonomous coding agents, we show that policy search directly in code space offers a compelling third path that combines automated optimization with explicit interpretability. We investigate a human-directed workflow in which coding agents iteratively propose, implement, evaluate, diagnose, and eventually refine algorithms guided by simulation feedback and explicit correctness verification. We conducted two case studies and found that this workflow robustly outperformed any manually engineered solutions. On a challenging map in the 2024 League of Robot Runners competition, a two-day search discovered a policy that exceeds the stronger locally reproduced competition entry by 35.0% on the densest instance and generalizes to unseen map instances.

translated_title: 面向多智能体寻路的代码空间策略搜索
translated_abstract: 为复杂多智能体系统开发协调策略通常依赖于劳动密集型的算法设计或不透明的任务特定强化学习。随着自主编码智能体领域的最新进展，我们展示了直接在代码空间中进行策略搜索提供了一条引人注目的第三条路径，它将自动化优化与显式可解释性相结合。我们研究了一种由人类主导的工作流程，其中编码智能体在仿真反馈和显式正确性验证的指导下，迭代地提出、实现、评估、诊断并最终改进算法。我们进行了两个案例研究，发现该工作流程稳健地超越了任何人工设计的解决方案。在2024年机器人竞技者联盟比赛中一张具有挑战性的地图上，为期两天的搜索发现了一种策略，在最密集的实例上比本地复现的较强竞赛方案高出35.0%，并且能够泛化到未见过的地图实例。
tldr: 该论文提出直接在代码空间中进行策略搜索的新范式，通过人类主导的编码智能体工作流程自动发现可解释的多智能体寻路协调策略，在2024年机器人竞技者联盟竞赛的挑战性地图上以35.0%的性能优势超越人工设计方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new paradigm of direct policy search in code space, where a human-directed coding-agent workflow automatically discovers interpretable multi-agent pathfinding coordination policies that outperform manually engineered solutions by 35.0% on a challenging 2024 League of Robot Runners competition map.
